question: Among all European Grand Prix races, what is the percentage of the races were hosted in Germany?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM races AS T1
JOIN CircuitDetails AS T3 ON T1.circuitId = T3.circuitId
JOIN CircuitLocation AS T2 ON T3.circuitId = T2.circuitId
WHERE T1.name = 'European Grand Prix'
